mission: Build ONE dossier in the published v2 format. Read docs/enrichment/dossiers/HANDOFF.md, README.md and DISAMBIGUATION.md first, then docs/enrichment/EXEMPLARS.md and docs/enrichment/HUMANIZER-SKILL.md.
standard: The Self (docs/enrichment/dossiers/the-self.md) and Anger (anger.md) are the exemplars: exhaustive map (every wiki card on the theme, grouped by subtheme), real divergences with verbatim-checked quotes from opened carriers, Variation-Selection(+Retention) practice section, Nearby terms section per DISAMBIGUATION.md; Story section (4th section, after Practice): the compendium's stories that best represent the theme's aspects, one-line loglines compressed from the story cards you actually open and read, with card links (spec: docs/enrichment/dossiers/README.md item 4; exemplars the-self.md and anger.md). If your dossier already exists without it, enrich the existing file with the section.
deliverables: docs/enrichment/sources/dossiers/<slug>.md (evidence ledger, every quote verified word-for-word against an opened carrier)
registry status flip to published is SUPERVISOR-ONLY: leave status 'planned' and flag in a commit message
the Academy data splice is SUPERVISOR-ONLY: do NOT edit site/assets/app.js or style.css; never edit registry.json, progress.json or the queues
verification: Every card link verified against actual content/ filenames by script before pushing. No hallucination: every fact and quote from a source actually opened (owner library: docs/PRIMARY-SOURCES.md). Humanised per HUMANIZER-SKILL.md.
push: git push over HTTPS is broken; commit locally then timeout 120 python3 scripts/api_push.py. Save after every item and every ~10 minutes.
baton: python3 scripts/baton.py clock-in <band> <agent-name>; clock in at every milestone; release when the band's list is exhausted.
source_queue: dossier roadmap mint 2026-10-24 (supervisor-pplx-dossiers-1024b): owner-directed dossier programme, registry docs/enrichment/dossiers/registry.json
note: Thinking styles, reasoning, belief formation, limits of reason. Contains the 'thoughts' territory. Decision-Making is a separate later dossier: point decision research at it as a nearby term.
pre_push_check: python3 scripts/dossier_check.py docs/enrichment/dossiers/<slug>.md (exit 0 required before pushing)

question_draft: see registry.json question_draft for this slug (docs/enrichment/dossiers/registry.json) — starting point only; refine the question from your opened sources before publishing
full_text_sweep: rg -il '<term>' content/ | sort  — run per family term after the title sweep to catch stragglers (cards whose body treats the term without it being in the title); verify substance by reading the card
story_section: Owner-directed 2026-10-24, mandatory: every dossier carries a 4th section "## Story: the stories that carry the theme" after Practice. Loglines are concrete incidents compressed from the story cards' own text (open and read each story file you cite; never restate the cards' historical or psychological claims); subthemes mirror the map's aspects; kernels stay in Practice. dossier_check.py fails any dossier without it. Published dossiers lacking it sit on STORY_MIGRATION in scripts/dossier_check.py (supervisor-owned): enrich the file, then flag completion in your commit message; the supervisor removes the slug. Never edit the shared checker yourself.
